risk_if_not_implemented: Without Media Transportation, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), System / Data Compromise (Non-Technical Vector) (R-BC-5), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Physical Crime (MT-5), Human Error (MT-9), Transportation / Logistics Disruption (MT-26).

compensating_control_1.name: Encrypting Data In Transit
compensating_control_1.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data in transit.
compensating_control_1.justification: Encrypting Data In Transit (CRY-05) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Media Transportation (DCH-16) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Cross-Organizational Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to coordinate sanitized event logs and security-relevant telemetry among external organizations to identify anomalous events when that data is shared across organizational boundaries, without giving away sensitive or critical business data.
compensating_control_2.justification: Cross-Organizational Monitoring (MON-36.1) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Media Transportation (DCH-16) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
